item.title: Applied AI For Distributors 2026 Is Different
item.description: After three years of analyzing and forecasting AI's potential, this year’s Applied AI for Distributors is laser-focused on practical implementation. Distribution leaders have moved past the “what ifs” — now they need to know how to get things done.

item.title: GF Creates Safer Homes with Uponor Radiant Heating for First Nations Communities in Canada
item.description: Through the GF Water Foundation, several First Nations homes in Saskatchewan have improved air quality and living conditions thanks to Uponor radiant heating.

item.description: The bill directly supports ACCA’s 2025-26 policy priority to strengthen the HVACR workforce by making federal workforce development funds more accessible to contractors’ in-house training programs.

item.title: Construction Dive: Construction Fatal Overdose, Suicide Rates Dropped in 2024
